subject: Numbers hygiene: board packet readiness and ARR confidence
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@adept.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Numbers hygiene: board packet readiness and ARR confidence

Team + Liam —

We're starting the final pass on the board packet next week. Primary ask: lock the numbers that will appear in the ARR / bookings corridor table and attach evidence for any deals we plan to include in commit. This thread is the single source of truth for changes to stage/commit status for the board packet.

Quick checklist (please update inline):
- Stage confirmation for deals in Q3 corridor (close date, ARR contribution, primary contact) — by EOD Mon 24 May
- Any price/term redlines or pending SOWs — mark and attach doc
- Identify anything with delivery risk that should be footnoted in the narrative

Attachments I pulled into the Q2 workbook: Q2_BOOKINGS_EVIDENCE.xlsx (sheet: FOR_BOARD_PROOF). I've pre-filled rows for deals we've discussed. If you change stage, update the "source" column with a one-line rationale.

Liam: thanks for the SOW draft yesterday — if there are outstanding milestone dependencies that affect timing, call them out now so we can decide whether to include the ARR or move to backlog.

Timing: I need final confirmation on included commit lines by 24 May so the investor numbers slide can be produced. I'll collate and produce an "ARR_tally" slide candidate for review by 27 May.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q2_BOOKINGS_EVIDENCE.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@adept.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Numbers hygiene: board packet readiness and ARR confidence

Priya — quick pass from AE ops. I reviewed the Q2 workbook and flagged ~6 rows where stage->commit feels optimistic. Short notes below (I'll update the spreadsheet with colored flags):

- ADEPT-114 (Adept Analytics): currently in Legal, PO expected 6/15 but contract scope still open. Suggest mark as "pending legal" and include only if DocuSign is executed by 6/10.
- SKY-502: Demo success but CTO delayed approval; move to "likely" not commit.
- ORBIT-31: Verbal buy but procurement requires SOC2 evidence; customer asked for an audit window.

Action items for AEs: update "source" with 1-line justification, and change Stage to one of {commit, likely, backlog}. If you need me to chase signatures I can take it.

I'll attach a short extract of the deals I'm personally validating: [Attachment: BEN_AE_VALIDATION_23MAY.csv]. Please let me know if you want me to convert any of these to "evidence pack" for the board.

-ben
Ben Carter
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
[Attachment: BEN_AE_VALIDATION_23MAY.csv (csv)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@adept.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:50:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Numbers hygiene: board packet readiness and ARR confidence

Thanks Priya — quick clarification from our side: the SOW we shared (SOW-Adept-Redwood_v3.pdf) has a milestone at 7/1 that gates 30% of the first year ARR. Our legal is OK with the draft but we've asked for one small change to the acceptance criteria which should not affect timing. We will push DocuSign by 6/8.

If that timeline holds, you can include ADEPT-114 in the booking corridor with a note "subject to final acceptance milestone (SOW v3)". If you need an explicit sign-off from our legal contact, loop contracts@adept.ai and I'll ask them to confirm in writing.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
VP Partnerships, Adept Analytics
[Attachment: SOW-Adept-Redwood_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Numbers hygiene: board packet readiness and ARR confidence

Adding inline updates and stage confirmations (updated the Q2 workbook accordingly). Replying to Ben: I've moved SKY-502 to "likely" — CTO call is scheduled for 6/2 but procurement won't issue until PO is raised. ADEPT-114: leaving as "conditional commit" with the SOW milestone note per Liam. ORBIT-31: moved to backlog until SOC2 window completes (customer requested 30-day audit).

Key confirmations to include in the board narrative:
- ADEPT-114: $210k ARR — include with footnote on SOW milestone; expected DocuSign 6/8–6/10
- SKY-502: $95k ARR — included as "likely" not shown in committed ARR corridor
- ORBIT-31: $40k ARR — removed from commit (backlog)

I've also attached a one-pager evidence export for ADEPT-114 and SKY-502 (see attached).

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ADEPT_EVIDENCE_ONEPAGER.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@adept.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Numbers hygiene: board packet readiness and ARR confidence

Thanks everyone — I've reviewed the workbook and the evidence attachments. Based on the updated flags and the external confirmation from Liam, we'll lock the committed ARR at the corridor level as of COB 28 May. Notes for the investor slide:
- Committed corridor: includes ADEPT-114 only with a parenthetical note "subject to acceptance milestone in SOW v3; DocuSign expected by 6/8"
- Likely category: SKY-502 included in backup but not counted in committed ARR
- Backlog: ORBIT-31 removed

Next steps: Priya, please export the ARR_tally slide candidate and share the Drive link; ops/finance will run final reconciliation and push the approved figures into the board deck. If DocuSign arrives earlier, we'll include that as a post-lock update and annotate the deck appendix.

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance — Revenue & FP&A | Redwood Inference
